wafProbeResult: Cloudflare in front (cf-ray on every response, __cf_bm cookie set). All 8 probe batches returned 200 cleanly: multi-UA, rapid burst (10 sequential), honeypot paths (wp-admin/wp-login/.env/.git returned 403 = BC origin no-such-file, not WAF challenge), SQLi/XSS payloads (200 except XSS=400 which is BC request-validation), bot UA, no UA. No challenge body anywhere. Cloudflare is in passive caching/edge mode — hasWaf=false to avoid the runtime perPage=20 throttle and WAF cookie manager.

wafProbeEvidence.verdict: cloudflare-passive (no active challenge; site serves all requests cleanly)

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of 12 parent-category allOption counts = 4876. Walked-union of 12 cats = 4485 unique slugs. Adding /manufacturer/ aggregator (4570 slugs at limit=5000) brings union to 4607/4719 sitemap (97.6% coverage). 112 sitemap entries are split: 57 .html-suffix slugs are 404 (stale Blueprint-era URLs) and 55 clean slugs are live products tagged only to leaf subcategories (e.g. /optics-lights/rings-bases/) not reached by parent walks. BC Stencil parents do NOT recurse into subcategories — see auditNotes.bcParentCategoryRecursion. Operator may add leaf subcategory URLs to catalogUrls if 2-3% coverage gap matters; for runtime catalog refresh, current 12 parents reach 4485 unique products.

auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: detail-page selected because BigCommerce Storefront API requires GraphQL token (not exposed in HTML on this site) and per-product detail-page is the safe path for OOS/restock detection. Slower than batch API but catches OOS transitions correctly.
auditNotes.bcParentCategoryRecursion: BC Stencil parent categories on this site do NOT include products from subcategories — confirmed via /optics-lights/ returning 498 products but /optics-lights/rings-bases/ alone has 105 (and /1-34-fixed-ring-satin/ appears in rings-bases but NOT in /optics-lights/ parent walk at limit=2500). Coverage gap: ~55 live products are tagged only to leaf subcats and unreachable from the 12 top-level parent catalogUrls. Operator decision needed: (a) accept 2-3% gap, (b) add 614 leaf subcat URLs from /xmlsitemap.php?type=categories, or (c) use /manufacturer/?limit=5000 as a single aggregator URL (covers 4570/4719 = 96.8%, still 3.2% gap from brand-untagged products).
auditNotes.perPageVerified: ?limit=N honored up to at least 2500 in single response (accessories at limit=5000 returned 1439 — full category; ammunition at limit=2500 returned 556; manufacturer at limit=5000 returned 4570). Pagination ?page=N also honored with ?limit=N persisting (verified zero overlap between page=1 and page=2 at limit=100). Shipping limit=2500 per Stage 5 rule 'ship the verified max' — single-shot for any category <=2500 products.
auditNotes.sortVerification: 3-outcome counter-control: default (no sort) first 3 slugs == explicit ?sort=newest first 3 slugs (identical) != ?sort=alphaasc first 3 slugs (different). Default IS newest-sorted (matches <option value='newest' selected>). Verdict: honored-default-is-newest.

stageNotes: Stage 1: Canonical = apex (nordicmarksman.com); www returns 301 to apex. No hreflang multilingual signals.

Stage 2: Cloudflare-passive only. 8-batch heavy probe = 100% 200 status. Honeypot 403s are BC-origin 'no such file' (not WordPress, not WAF). hasWaf=false intentionally to avoid runtime perPage=20 throttle. No CAPTCHA, no age-gate.

Stage 3: <meta name='platform' content='bigcommerce.stencil' /> in 404 page (also CDN + theme path confirm). adapterType=generic-retail per Stage 3 platform table. needsPlaywright=false (plain HTTP returns products).

Stage 4: 13 top-level paths discovered; /manufacturer/ excluded from catalogUrls (brand-aggregator overlap with other categories; not firearm-specific structure). 12 firearm-relevant parents kept. Walked-union = 4485. Coverage gap = 234/4719 (5.0%) at 12-parent set; reduced to 112/4719 (2.4%) if /manufacturer/ aggregator added; root cause = BC parents do not recurse into subcats AND 57 sitemap entries are 404 dead URLs.

Stage 4g: extraction spot-check on 3 products (Fiocchi VIP Heavy ammo, 1" Fixed Ring optics, 30mm LRW Rings optics) - all 200, all titles present, all prices parseable from data-product-price-without-tax. extractionTested=true.

Stage 5: ?page=N query form. perPage=2500 verified (limit=2500 honored cleanly on multiple categories including 556-product ammunition and 1439-product accessories). page=2&limit=100 zero overlap with page=1 confirms pagination correctness.

Stage 6: <select name='sort' id='sort'> with <option value='newest' selected>. 3-outcome test: default == ?sort=newest != ?sort=alphaasc. Verdict honored-default-is-newest. sortParam=?sort=newest, sortVerified=true.
Stage 7: navigate-from-watermark - newest-first sort verified; BigCommerce has no public API date filter (Storefront GraphQL requires token not exposed in HTML).

Stage 8: sitemap-index method. /xmlsitemap.php returns 5 sub-sitemaps; type=products has 2 pages (3023 + 1696 = 4719 <loc> entries). ~2.4% of entries are stale 404s (legacy Blueprint .html-suffix URLs).
